k-ω SST, foamRun incompressibleFluid, PIMPLE with local time stepping (the tutorial's fvSolution: nCorrectors 2, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 2, maxCo 1); U (-5.51, 0, 0) m/s (25 US gal/min), k 0.4555 m2/s2, omega 922.8 1/s; PIMPLE solution converged in 2059 iterations (residualControl U 5e-4, p 1e-3, k and omega 1e-4); 0 -> 900 (clock 2405 s), restarted 900 -> 2059 (clock 2965 s), 8 MPI ranks, 2026-10-01; OpenFOAM 13-18870c24d21c

dictionaries from OOR `tutorials/uvReactorSozzi2006` (`659ec4a`) with SST, set up in an unmerged aquaflux branch; no committed script writes the case, so its dictionaries and log are copied into `data/records/raw/sozzi_slide10/flow_*`
diffuseEmitter on `lamp0_wall` and `lamp0_tip_B`, M = 696.42 W/m² (35 W over 0.80 m); absorption 35.67 /m; every other wall black

OOR `659ec4a`, 8 MPI ranks, convergence 1e-5 (15 sweeps at 72 directions, 15 at 288); uniform angular grids, nPhi = nTheta, every bin 30° or 15° square (Fluent: 3 × 3 and 6 × 6 θ × φ divisions per octant)

radiationDose at OOR `b23582b` (PR #90: the `langevin` dispersion model, one integrator with a continuous step, on `main` with #88 and #89); the tutorial's postProcess.dict: patchInjection on inlet, 10000 requested (9987 seeded), seed 42, dtMax 5 ms, cflMax 0.5, maxTime 300 s, wallReflection true, kInact (0.1); dispersion { type langevin; omega omega; Cmu 0.09; Cl 0.15 } (maxStepFraction 0.02, minLagrangianTime 1e-2 s, defaults); motion tracer; one OpenMP thread

solved in ANSYS Fluent on this mesh with 3 × 3 and 6 × 6 θ × φ divisions per octant (72 and 288 directions); the exports (`sozzi_fluent_3_3.cgns`, `sozzi_fluent_6_6.cgns`, CGNS 4.3) carry `Incident_Radiation` only and do not record the Fluent version, pixelation or scheme. of-mesh-converter (github.com/DeGrootResearchGroup/of-mesh-converter) `b654443` (PR #2, open): `transfer` matched their cells by centre (1232629, one to one and 1232629, one to one, largest distance 1.3e-15 m) and wrote G into `swap/fluent33/2059` and `swap/fluent66/2059`, copies of the slide 15 swap set's flow; traced at 2059 like the swap set
